sentences.zh: 因为重要的不是你赢了还是输了。

sentences.en: It's whether you win.
sentences.zh: 重要的是你是否赢了。

sentences.en: But that year, we see in these documents that his core businesses, his real estate and hotels, lose another $42 million that he shows on his tax returns there.
sentences.zh: 但那一年，我们在这些文件中看到，他的核心业务，即房地产和酒店，又亏损了4200万美元，他在税表中显示了这一点。

sentences.en: He makes some money in interest income that we don't know the source of that starts to rise up.
sentences.zh: 他通过利息收入赚了一些钱，我们不知道来源，这部分收入开始上升。

sentences.en: But still, it's not enough to take him out of the red.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，这还不足以让他扭亏为盈。

sentences.en: He's still registering huge amounts of losses that year.
sentences.zh: 他那一年仍然记录了巨额亏损。

sentences.en: And not talking about that, of course, or not mentioning it in his book.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们不是在谈论那个，或者说他的书里根本没提过。

sentences.en: At this point, what is the value for Donald Trump in staging this kind of public deception, in building up the Art of the Deal, super successful version of himself,
sentences.zh: 在当时，唐纳德·特朗普通过这种公开欺骗的手段，打造出那个“交易的艺术”中超级成功的自我形象，对他来说有什么价值呢？

sentences.en: when in fact, as we can see from these numbers that you now have, that wasn't the case?
sentences.zh: 因为事实上，正如我们从你现在掌握的这些数据中所看到的，情况并非如此。

sentences.en: What's the value of basically perpetuating an untrue version of himself?
sentences.zh: 本质上，维持一个虚假的自我形象有什么价值？

sentences.en: Well, I think at that point in time, the myth was the value to him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为在那个时间点，这种神话对他而言就是价值所在。

sentences.en: He wasn't able to monetize that directly until much later.
sentences.zh: 直到很久以后，他才能够直接将这种形象变现。

sentences.en: But you do see that it does enable him to obtain financing for things.
sentences.zh: 但你确实能看出，这让他能够为各种项目获得融资。

sentences.en: I also think in Manhattan, it opened not just doors on Wall Street, but it just opened doors to a life for him.
sentences.zh: 我还认为在曼哈顿，这不仅为他打开了华尔街的大门，更开启了他的一种生活方式。

sentences.en: It opened doors to the best restaurants and the best clubs.
sentences.zh: 这让他得以出入最高级的餐厅和俱乐部。

sentences.en: He's living this incredible life in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 他在曼哈顿过着令人难以置信的生活。

sentences.en: But in 1990, there's a huge reckoning.
sentences.zh: 但在1990年，他遭遇了巨大的清算。

sentences.en: So by 1990, we see all these debt-heavy acquisitions that he's been making really come to rooSt.
sentences.zh: 所以到了1990年，我们看到他之前所有那些高负债的收购项目真的让他陷入了困境。

sentences.en: His tax returns show a loss, a total loss on his core businesses of $262 million.
sentences.zh: 他的纳税申报单显示，他的核心业务总共亏损了2.62亿美元。

sentences.en: And the next year, he would lose an additional $255 million.
sentences.zh: 而第二年，他又额外亏损了2.55亿美元。

sentences.en: Everything's collapsing.
sentences.zh: 一切都在崩溃。

sentences.en: The bankruptcy start on his casinos.
sentences.zh: 他的赌场开始破产。

sentences.en: He stops paying his mortgage loans.
sentences.zh: 他停止偿还抵押贷款。

sentences.en: He can't sustain it anymore, and he's got regulators looking at every aspect of his finances.
sentences.zh: 他再也支撑不下去了，监管机构正在审查他财务的方方面面。

sentences.en: So now what we can see from this entire period of time, 1985 through 1995, is that his core businesses lost $1.2 billion.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，从1985年到1995年这段完整的时间里，我们可以看到他的核心业务亏损了12亿美元。

sentences.en: Which is staggering.
sentences.zh: 这简直令人震惊。

sentences.en: It is a staggering amount of money to lose over the course of a decade.
sentences.zh: 在十年间亏损如此巨额的资金，确实令人震惊。

sentences.en: And keep in mind that when you lose money in a business, you can use that as sort of a credit against future income.
sentences.zh: 请记住，当你在生意中亏损时，你可以将其作为抵扣未来收入的某种抵免额。

sentences.en: You can earn that much money without paying any taxes on it for years to come.
sentences.zh: 在未来的几年里，你可以赚取同样多的钱而无需缴纳任何税款。

sentences.en: In 1990, he has $400 million in losses that he can use to write off income for the next 18 years.
sentences.zh: 1990年，他有4亿美元的亏损，可以用来抵扣未来18年的收入。

sentences.en: The next year, that grows to $665 million.
sentences.zh: 第二年，这个数字增长到了6.65亿美元。

sentences.en: In losses.
sentences.zh: 全是亏损。

sentences.en: In losses that he can carry forward to write off income in future years.
sentences.zh: 这些亏损可以结转到未来几年用于抵扣收入。

sentences.en: And we know from our prior reporting on this, that that figure would continue to grow to almost a billion dollars about three years later.
sentences.zh: 我们从之前的报道中得知，大约三年后，这个数字继续增长到了近10亿美元。

sentences.en: And those losses were so big that by 1994, they accounted for 1.7% of all losses declared by individual taxpayers.
sentences.zh: 这些亏损规模之大，以至于到1994年，它们占到了个人纳税人申报总亏损额的1.7%。

sentences.en: I just want to wrap my head around this.
sentences.zh: 我得好好消化一下这个概念。

sentences.en: His losses that year represent almost 2% of all losses in the entirety of the United States.
sentences.zh: 他那一年的亏损几乎占到了全美所有个人亏损总额的2%。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's incredible.
sentences.zh: 是的，这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: There's 114-plus million taxpayers, and his losses account for 1.7% of all the losses in America that year for individuals.
sentences.zh: 全美有超过1.14亿纳税人，而他的亏损占了那一年全美个人亏损总额的1.7%。

sentences.en: That's how big it was.
sentences.zh: 这就是它的规模之大。

sentences.en: It was insane.
sentences.zh: 简直疯狂。

sentences.en: And remind us, since you have seen Trump's father's tax documents for your previous investigation, how is Fred Trump doing financially during this period?
sentences.zh: 提醒我们一下，既然你在之前的调查中看过特朗普父亲的税务文件，那么在此期间，弗雷德·特朗普的财务状况如何？

sentences.en: Well, in fact, Fred Trump's doing swimmingly well during this entire period.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实上，弗雷德·特朗普在这一整段时期内都过得非常顺遂。

sentences.en: During just one six-year window of it, Donald Trump loses on his core businesses $840 million, while his father declares a positive income during those years of $95 million.
sentences.zh: 仅在他六年的一段窗口期内，唐纳德·特朗普的核心业务就亏损了8.4亿美元，而他父亲在这些年里申报的净收入为9500万美元。

sentences.en: That's a tremendous gap.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的差距。

sentences.en: And you can see for the same years that Donald Trump was, you know, bleeding red onto his tax return, that Fred Trump was doing just fine.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到，在唐纳德·特朗普的纳税申报单上“血流成河”的那些年里，弗雷德·特朗普却过得相当不错。

sentences.en: And really, the only two losing things that we see he did in those years was invest in his son.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，他在那些年里做的唯一两件亏本的事，就是投资他的儿子。

sentences.en: In one case, he followed his son's efforts to manipulate his stock.
sentences.zh: 其中一次，他跟随儿子的脚步去操纵股票。

sentences.en: He lost a couple million dollars on that.
sentences.zh: 他在那上面亏了几百万美元。

sentences.en: In another case, some of the loans he had given to his son, he just wrote off as a tax loss of $15 million during this period of time also.
sentences.zh: 另一次，他给儿子的一些贷款，他直接在这段时间里将其作为1500万美元的税务亏损注销了。

sentences.en: Those are really the only things he ever did that didn't turn out well.
sentences.zh: 这些确实是他做过的唯一不成功的事情。

sentences.en: So, intriguingly, your investigation into Donald Trump's taxes, which you've been waiting so long to understand,
sentences.zh: 那么，有趣的是，你对唐纳德·特朗普税务的调查，也就是你等待了这么久才得以了解的调查，

sentences.en: they end up reflecting back and kind of confirming your original conclusion from the investigation of Fred Trump's taxes, which is that he's bailing out his son.
sentences.zh: 最终反映并证实了你最初从弗雷德·特朗普税务调查中得出的结论，那就是他在救助自己的儿子。

sentences.en: And he is the success that his son is struggling, if not failing, to replicate.
sentences.zh: 而且他才是那个唐纳德正在努力模仿，却甚至可能正在失败的成功典范。

sentences.en: I think that's true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是事实。

sentences.en: Fred Trump was steady Eddie.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·特朗普是个稳健的人。

sentences.en: He designed his businesses with very low debt.
sentences.zh: 他设计的商业模式负债率非常低。

sentences.en: He knew what the rents were going to be.
sentences.zh: 他很清楚租金收入会是多少。

sentences.en: They produced income every year for his entire life, and his children's lives beyond that.
sentences.zh: 这些资产在他的一生中，以及他子女的一生中，每年都能产生收入。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was trying for something different, and it didn't work out.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普试图尝试不同的路子，但结果并不理想。

sentences.en: So, what is this new information, this 10 years of tax return data that you have obtained, really tell us that we didn't know before?
sentences.zh: 那么，你所获得的这份新的信息，即这10年的纳税申报数据，到底告诉了我们什么我们之前不知道的事情？

sentences.en: This new information, I think, the main thing when I kind of pour over all the numbers, is this is the one period, if I were to have guessed before,
sentences.zh: 这份新信息，我认为，当我仔细研读所有数字时，最主要的一点是，如果我之前猜测过，

sentences.en: or I saw the actual numbers, that he had possibly made some money, this is it.
sentences.zh: 或者在我看到实际数字之前，认为他可能赚到了一些钱，那就是这一时期。

sentences.en: And now you can see that it just isn't.
sentences.zh: 但现在你可以看到，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Let me play devil's advocate for just a moment.
sentences.zh: 让我暂时扮演一下魔鬼代言人。

sentences.en: Is there a universe in which these losses represent a business savvy by someone who understands how to carry forward losses or even make them look bigger and bigger over time in order to not pay taxes?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能，这些亏损代表了一种商业精明，即某人懂得如何结转亏损，甚至随着时间的推移让亏损看起来越来越大，从而达到避税的目的？

sentences.en: Is this somebody who is essentially playing all the possible legal games with the tax code by embracing end-of-year losses on his returns?
sentences.zh: 这是否是一个通过利用年终亏损来充分利用税法中所有合法手段的人？

sentences.en: I think if these were losses that you were seeing, whether it was losses on the bottom line of one or two million dollars,
sentences.zh: 我想，如果这些亏损是你所看到的，无论是底线亏损一两百万美元，

sentences.en: there was something in proportion to what he actually owned at that period of time, you might be able to say, wow, this is just really brilliant accounting.
sentences.zh: 还是与他当时实际拥有的资产成比例的亏损，你或许可以说，哇，这真是天才的会计手段。

sentences.en: Somehow they're making all this work.
sentences.zh: 他们不知怎么地让这一切都行得通。

sentences.en: But we're so beyond that in these numbers.
sentences.zh: 但我们在这些数字中看到的已经远远超出了那个范畴。

sentences.en: We're orders of magnitude past that.
sentences.zh: 这已经是几个数量级的差距了。

sentences.en: There's actual real money being lost here in a lot of it.
sentences.zh: 这里面有很大一部分是实实在在的真金白银在亏损。

sentences.en: When we think about why President Trump is so deeply reluctant to release his tax returns, any of them,
sentences.zh: 当我们思考为什么特朗普总统如此极度抗拒公开他的纳税申报单，任何一份都不愿意公开时，

sentences.en: how do figures like the ones that you found here for this period help explain why that might be?
sentences.zh: 你在这里发现的这一时期的数字，如何帮助解释其中的原因？

sentences.en: Well, just imagine that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，试想一下。

sentences.en: This is his whole reason for being a national figure, is the idea that he's a business genius.
sentences.zh: 他作为国家级人物存在的全部理由，就是他是一个商业天才的形象。

sentences.en: But you just can't reconcile that with the fact that over a 10-year period, he lost $1.2 billion on his own businesses.
sentences.zh: 但你无法将这一点与他在10年间个人业务亏损12亿美元的事实调和起来。

sentences.en: You can't make those two things work together.
sentences.zh: 你无法让这两件事共存。

sentences.en: And I think a big fear of his, if his tax returns and the modern ones come out,
sentences.zh: 我认为他的一大恐惧是，如果他的纳税申报单，尤其是近期的那些被公开，

sentences.en: is we're going to see if his businesses, if they are profitable, that they're not as profitable as he says.
sentences.zh: 我们将看到他的业务即便盈利，也远没有他所说的那么赚钱。

sentences.en: And we're going to be able to see that in black and white on a form that he sent to the IRS.
sentences.zh: 我们将能够在提交给国税局的表格上黑纸白字地看到这一点。

sentences.en: I keep thinking of this thing that he said back in this period of time.
sentences.zh: 我一直想起他在那个时期说过的一句话。

sentences.en: I don't need to make more money.
sentences.zh: 我不需要赚更多的钱。

sentences.en: I have all the money I'll ever need.
sentences.zh: 我已经拥有了我所需要的一切财富。

sentences.en: Is that really the essence of what we're seeing here?
sentences.zh: 这真的是我们在这里所看到的本质吗？

sentences.en: His business interests shift through the years.
sentences.zh: 他的商业利益多年来一直在变。

sentences.en: He changes from golf courses to hotels to licensing deals.
sentences.zh: 他从高尔夫球场转向酒店，再到授权交易。

sentences.en: Was all that just a billboard for the Trump name?
sentences.zh: 这一切难道只是为了给“特朗普”这个名字做广告吗？

sentences.en: And he already had enough money to be rich and for his children to be rich throughout his life.
sentences.zh: 而且他已经拥有足够的钱让自己富有，也足够让他的孩子们一生富有。

sentences.en: I think you could tell that from his tax returns.
sentences.zh: 我想你可以从他的纳税申报单中看出这一点。

sentences.en: I don't think that's a fact he would ever want anyone to know.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是他希望任何人知道的事实。

sentences.en: That in reality, all the money he ever wanted came from his dad.
sentences.zh: 那就是实际上，他想要的所有钱都来自他的父亲。

sentences.en: And without that support, he would never have been this successful.
sentences.zh: 如果没有那种支持，他永远不会取得这样的成功。

sentences.en: I couldn't say any better than that.
sentences.zh: 我无法说得比这更好了。

sentences.en: And what does that really matter, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，这又有什么关系呢？

sentences.en: Well, inherited money, showmanship versus money.
sentences.zh: 嗯，继承的财富，作秀与金钱的对比。

sentences.en: He's president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 他是美国总统。

sentences.en: Why does it matter?
sentences.zh: 这为什么重要？

sentences.en: It's a great point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的观点。

sentences.en: If his point for being president was that I'm here to do public service, I'm here to return something to the country that has given me and my family so much, it wouldn't matter,
sentences.zh: 如果他当总统的目的是“我来这里是为了公共服务，我来这里是为了回馈这个给予我和我的家庭如此之多的国家”，那这就不重要了，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: People would know that he was independently wealthy, but I don't think it would be a central issue to your perception of him.
sentences.zh: 人们会知道他本身就很富有，但我不认为这会成为你对他看法的一个核心问题。

sentences.en: But he's there for a different reason.
sentences.zh: 但他出现在那里是有不同原因的。

sentences.en: He's there because he's saying my ideas matter because I've had brilliant success in everything I've touched.
sentences.zh: 他出现在那里是因为他说我的想法很重要，因为我在接触的每一件事上都取得了辉煌的成功。

sentences.en: He's there because he says everything he's touched has turned to gold.
sentences.zh: 他出现在那里是因为他说他接触的一切都变成了黄金。

sentences.en: That's his reason for being that's his primary argument for his own intelligence, for all of his ideas and why they matter.
sentences.zh: 那是他存在的理由，是他对自己智慧、对自己所有想法以及它们为何重要的主要论据。

sentences.en: So that essential fact has to matter as well.
sentences.zh: 所以那个基本事实也必须很重要。

sentences.en: But the thing I'm really thinking about when I think about Donald Trump's tax returns is, you know,
sentences.zh: 但当我思考唐纳德·特朗普的纳税申报单时，我真正想到的是，你知道，

sentences.en: we have spent so much time looking at Trump's finances in terms of what did his father give him.
sentences.zh: 我们花了太多时间从他父亲给了他什么的角度来看待特朗普的财务状况。

sentences.en: And we know a lot up until 1995, but it really becomes a bit of a black hole beyond that.
sentences.zh: 我们对1995年之前的情况了解很多，但那之后的事情确实变成了一个黑洞。

sentences.en: And we don't know really anything about the sources of his income and who is standing behind him.
sentences.zh: 我们对他的收入来源以及谁在支持他一无所知。

sentences.en: In short, he could be getting money from corporations, from countries, from banks, from a whole host of places.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他可能从公司、国家、银行以及各种各样的地方获得资金。

sentences.en: And we have no idea.
sentences.zh: 而我们对此一无所知。

sentences.en: And I think that the reason why this fight is escalating and he does not want his tax returns out to the point where he's suing his bank, his accounting firm,
sentences.zh: 我认为这场斗争之所以升级，他之所以不想公开纳税申报单，甚至不惜起诉他的银行、会计师事务所，

sentences.en: and he's willing to go to court over this.
sentences.zh: 并且愿意为此对簿公堂，

sentences.en: There's got to be something there he doesn't want us to see.
sentences.zh: 一定是因为里面有什么他不想让我们看到的东西。

sentences.en: But I think one of the biggest things embedded in his tax returns is his sources of income.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他纳税申报单中隐藏的最重要的事情之一就是他的收入来源。

sentences.en: I'm curious what the White House has said in response to this latest round of reporting that you both have done.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇白宫对你们两人所做的这一轮最新报道有何回应。

sentences.en: They've told us that the information that we have is demonstrably false.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们，我们掌握的信息是明显错误的。

sentences.en: Of course, there's an easy way for them to sort that out, and that's to provide us with Donald Trump's actual taxes so we can compare it all.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们有一个简单的方法来澄清这一点，那就是向我们提供唐纳德·特朗普真实的税务文件，这样我们就可以进行对比。

sentences.en: They haven't done that.
sentences.zh: 他们没有这样做。

sentences.en: Sue and Russ, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 苏和拉斯，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: In Washington, the battle over access to President Trump's tax returns has sharpened in recent days amid partisan warfare over the findings of the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿，随着穆勒报告调查结果引发的党派之争，围绕获取特朗普总统纳税申报单的斗争在最近几天愈演愈烈。

sentences.en: On Monday, the president's Treasury Secretary, Steve Mnuchin,
sentences.zh: 周一，总统的财政部长史蒂夫·姆努钦表示，

sentences.en: said he would not fulfill a request from the democratically controlled House Ways and Means Committee to provide the returns,
sentences.zh: 他不会满足民主党控制的众议院筹款委员会提出的提供这些申报单的要求，

sentences.en: while the president has filed lawsuits against his banks and accounting firm to prevent them from turning over his returns and other financial records to congressional committees.
sentences.zh: 而总统已对其银行和会计师事务所提起诉讼，以阻止他们将他的申报单和其他财务记录移交给国会委员会。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in New York, lawmakers say they intend to advance a bill today that would allow those committees to see the president's New York state tax returns.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在纽约，立法者表示他们打算在今天推进一项法案，允许这些委员会查看总统的纽约州纳税申报单。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间去探索付费墙后的内容，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The Democrats are angry.
sentences.zh: 民主党人很愤怒。

sentences.en: Angry that the facts disappointed them.
sentences.zh: 愤怒于事实让他们失望了。

sentences.en: Angry that our legal system will not magically undo the 2016 election for them.
sentences.zh: 愤怒于我们的法律体系不会像变魔术一样为他们推翻2016年的选举结果。

sentences.en: In a speech from the Senate floor on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 周二在参议院发言时，

sentences.en: Republican Majority Leader Mitch McConnell said it was time for Democrats to end their investigations into President Trump's 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 共和党多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔表示，现在是民主党结束对特朗普总统2016年竞选活动调查的时候了。

sentences.en: They're grieving.
sentences.zh: 他们在悲伤。

sentences.en: They're grieving.
sentences.zh: 他们在悲伤。

sentences.en: That the national crisis they spent two years wishing for.
sentences.zh: 因为他们花了两年时间所期盼的国家危机。

sentences.en: Did not materialize.
sentences.zh: 并没有发生。

sentences.en: But for the rest of the country, it's just good news.
sentences.zh: 但对于全国其他地区来说，这只是个好消息。

sentences.en: McConnell based his claim on the special counsel's finding that there was no coordination between the campaign and Russia,
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔的说法基于特别检察官的调查结果，即竞选团队与俄罗斯之间没有勾结，

sentences.en: but ignored the discovery of significant evidence that Trump may have obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 但他忽略了特朗普可能妨碍司法公正的重要证据的发现。

sentences.en: Case closed.
sentences.zh: 结案。

sentences.en: Case closed.
sentences.zh: 结案。

sentences.en: In a rebuttal, Democratic Minority Leader Chuck Schumer called McConnell's speech a, quote, whitewashing, and said that Democrats had no plans to end their investigations.
sentences.zh: 在反驳中，民主党少数党领袖查克·舒默称麦康奈尔的演讲是“粉饰太平”，并表示民主党没有结束调查的计划。

sentences.en: So our leader says, let's move on?
sentences.zh: 所以我们的领袖说，让我们继续前进？

sentences.en: It's sort of like Richard Nixon saying, let's move on, at the height of the investigation of his wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 这就像理查德·尼克松在针对他违法行为的调查达到顶峰时说，让我们向前看一样。

sentences.en: Of course he wants to move on.
sentences.zh: 他当然想向前看。

sentences.en: He wants to cover up.
sentences.zh: 他想掩盖真相。

sentences.en: He wants to silence.
sentences.zh: 他想封住别人的嘴。

sentences.en: Not long after, in the latest showdown between the White House and Congress, the Trump administration invoked executive privilege to prevent former White House counsel Don McGahn
sentences.zh: 不久之后，在白宫与国会的最新对峙中，特朗普政府援引行政特权，阻止前白宫法律顾问唐·麦克加恩

sentences.en: from complying with a subpoena to provide documents to the democratically controlled House Judiciary Committee.
sentences.zh: 遵守传票，向民主党控制的众议院司法委员会提供文件。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro, listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》，欢迎在各大播客平台收听。
